title: Levandulová cesta (S01E07)
plot: Dvojčata na cestě za Domem osvícení dojdou na rozcestí.(Apple TV+)

reviews.author: LachtanShows
reviews.text: Tenhle seroš není žádným šlágrem, v rámci výpravných televizních dobrodružství, kterých je v současnosti méně než šafránu, se ale nadmíru bavím.(29.11.2021)

reviews.author: warrenur
reviews.text: Zhodnem sa na tom, ze kvalita a atmosfera postupne klesa. Road-trip nebol az taky exoticky, ako by sa zdalo, ale reflektorovy zavere opat nahodil navnadu. ;) 45%  Som zvedavy, ci sa poslednym dielom uzavrie nielen kapitola, ale i pribeh.(15.09.2020)

reviews.author: vodkasesemte
reviews.text:
The most unsettling sounding the human experience issilence. Ne, je to otravný psí štěkání. When nature begs for wailing. Silence in a birth, silence in a moment of devastating heartbreak. Silence during the infliction of such extreme pain. You have done yourself proud. Your defiance is powerful.
Some men in my position might find themselvees affected by it suddenly fighting the onset of pity, their resolve weakened. Just to be clear, those men are cowards. Theres a reason why I am in this position, and they arent (ano, tady čárka má bejt).To bylo fakt hloupý vznést požadavek na výkupné královny osobně.Prej my scouts have found no signs of them.Oni mají skauty!I have forgotten about killing more you will ever know.
The bell rings and you will suffer for it.Dobře si ji dědek natírá na chleba. Taky má spoustu pochopení.Hes not gripped by the same darkness. You remember when I first came to you? The rage and how destrictive I was?  Bcs I was afraid to trust you. Afraid to believe that I actually escaped and that it was true. You stayed so that I would know I was not alone.
Levander, I taste death. A new world lies beyond. A new god resides within. Enter and be seen. Enter and be judged. Enter and find death. He lost his fucking mind. Napadlo mě to.Nestačilo by tam dát ceduli s nápisem soukromý pozemek?I m asking for your eyes which is not your opinion.Prej plan. Otázka spíš je, proč byl ten dědek tak blbej, a požádal o výkupný, když se dozvěděl, kdo mu tam leží. Mohl ji zrovna tak zabít, aby se nikdo nedozvěděl, že zbil královnu. Fakt neměl žádnej motiv, vykopal si sám hrob.I dont want to be queen bcs the machines work. The gods took the dam, destroyed it with a rage. And took it with true heretics. The weak, the selfish, the backward.Dneska takový hodnoty oslavujeme!Go now before its to dark for you to see.(16.11.2021)
